Chem SI Assistant's example project (made-up data: NaBH4 reduction of aryl methyl ketones),
from github.com/nathanohare/chem-si-assistant (si_assistant/example/Example project), with
its JSON, text and molfiles only (its spectra PDFs and HRMS reports are left out).
tests/si-project.test.ts opens it and saves it back to check nothing changes.
